title: Floating Boat in Cosmic Sky
description: A hooded figure stands in a wooden Viking-style boat that floats above golden rolling hills, with one hand extended toward a glowing yellow sun on the horizon. The sky blends from orange sunset to deep blue night filled with stars, while a large swirling green and purple cosmic cloud with glowing eyes dominates the left side.
prompt: A hooded figure stands in a wooden Viking longboat that floats above golden rolling hills, one hand extended forward. The sky transitions from bright orange sunset with a glowing yellow sun on the horizon to deep blue night sky with stars. A large swirling green and purple cosmic cloud formation with glowing circular eyes fills the left side of the image. The entire scene is a finished fantasy painting.
